capability_analysis.core_action: Replace the text input field for target account with a dropdown select component
inputs_required: List of available accounts for the current user
outputs_expected: Dropdown component rendered in place of text input
Selected account UUID stored in form state
Form submission includes selected account UUID
state_changes: targetAccountId state updated when dropdown selection changes
Form validation passes when account is selected
side_effects: Form validation logic may need adjustment for dropdown vs text input
affected_components: Potentially TransactionContext for fetching available accounts

acceptance_criteria_analysis.criteria: Target account field displays as a dropdown with all known accounts listed
acceptance_criteria_analysis.gherkin: Given a user is on the transaction form, When they click the target account field, Then a dropdown list of available accounts is displayed
dependencies: Must have list of available accounts loaded
acceptance_criteria_analysis.notes: Need to fetch accounts from API or context

acceptance_criteria_analysis.criteria: Dropdown shows account identifiers in a user-friendly format (not raw UUID)
acceptance_criteria_analysis.gherkin: Given the dropdown is open, When accounts are displayed, Then each account shows a readable identifier (e.g., account name or formatted display)
dependencies: Account data must include display name or label
acceptance_criteria_analysis.notes: Need to determine account display format (name, account number, etc.)

acceptance_criteria_analysis.criteria: Selecting an account from the dropdown populates the form field with the correct account UUID
acceptance_criteria_analysis.gherkin: Given a user selects an account from the dropdown, When the selection is made, Then the form field is populated with the account's UUID
acceptance_criteria_analysis.notes: Verify that targetAccountId state is updated with UUID, not display name

acceptance_criteria_analysis.criteria: The dropdown is populated with all accounts available to the current user
acceptance_criteria_analysis.gherkin: Given a user opens the transaction form, When the dropdown is rendered, Then it contains all accounts the user has access to
dependencies: Must have access to user's account list
acceptance_criteria_analysis.notes: Need to determine source of account list (API endpoint, context, props)

edge_cases.scenario: User has no accounts to select from
edge_cases.acceptance_criteria: Dropdown displays empty state or disabled with message 'No accounts available'
Dropdown displays single account and can be selected

edge_cases.scenario: User has large number of accounts
Dropdown is rendering while accounts are being fetched
edge_cases.acceptance_criteria: Show loading state or skeleton in dropdown

edge_cases.scenario: API call to fetch accounts fails
edge_cases.acceptance_criteria: Show error message and allow user to retry or fallback to text input

edge_cases.scenario: User's account access changes between page load and form submission
edge_cases.acceptance_criteria: Form validation catches invalid account selection
Graceful error handling with retry option

existing_code: TransactionForm component - needs modification to use dropdown
TransactionContext - may need to provide account list
AuthContext - may provide current user context
types.ts - may need new Account interface
new_code: Account fetching logic (if not already available)
Dropdown component or use existing UI library component
infrastructure: API endpoint to fetch user's available accounts

blocked_by: Must have API endpoint for fetching user's accounts
related: Any other features using account selection

domain_knowledge: How accounts are structured in the system
What account metadata is available for display
technical_knowledge: Form handling patterns in the codebase

open_questions.question: Should the dropdown support search/filter for users with many accounts?
How should we handle the case where the account list fails to load?
Should we pre-select the user's primary/current account as default?

resolved_questions.question: What is the source of the account list?
resolved_questions.resolution: A new API endpoint will be created to fetch all accounts in the system. This endpoint will be called when the TransactionForm component mounts.

resolved_questions.question: What should be displayed in the dropdown for each account?
resolved_questions.resolution: Display the account name only. The UUID will be hidden from the user but stored internally for form submission.
